parameters.query:
INSERT INTO pages
  (order_id, slug, template_slug, couple_names, anniversary_date, youtube_url, theme, published_at)
VALUES (
  ($1::jsonb->>'order_id')::uuid,
  $1::jsonb->>'slug',
  COALESCE($1::jsonb->>'template_slug', 'midnight-letter'),
  COALESCE($1::jsonb->'couple_names', '{}'::jsonb),
  NULLIF($1::jsonb->>'anniversary_date', '')::date,
  NULLIF($1::jsonb->>'youtube_url', ''),
  '{}'::jsonb,
  now()
)
RETURNING id, slug;

nodes.name: Insert Page
nodes.notes: publishes immediately (published_at = now()). Parameterized via one $1::jsonb payload.

nodes.name: Download Photo
nodes.notes: Tally file URLs carry a token and download without login (PLAN §14).

nodes.name: Upload to R2
nodes.notes: TODO(verify): R2 SigV4 region must be "auto"; see Prepare R2 Object.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO photos (page_id, r2_key, url, position, alt)
SELECT
  ($1::jsonb #>> '{}')::uuid,
  elem->>'r2_key',
  elem->>'url',
  COALESCE((elem->>'position')::int, (ordinality - 1)::int),
  elem->>'alt'
FROM jsonb_array_elements($2::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(elem, ordinality);

nodes.name: Insert Photos
nodes.notes: Parameterized: page id + photos array as $1/$2. alt/url with quotes or commas are safe.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO messages (page_id, body, position, origin)
SELECT
  ($1::jsonb #>> '{}')::uuid,
  value,
  (ordinality - 1)::int,
  'client'
FROM jsonb_array_elements_text($2::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(value, ordinality);

nodes.name: Insert Messages
nodes.notes: Parameterized: page id + message array. Message text with quotes or newlines is safe.

nodes.notes: true = shared secret matches -> continue; false -> 401 and stop.

nodes.name: Respond Accepted
nodes.notes: Requires the Webhook node responseMode = responseNode. Responds immediately, the run keeps going.

nodes.name: Respond Unauthorized
nodes.notes: Requires the Webhook node responseMode = responseNode. Responds immediately, the run keeps going.

nodes.name: Stop: Unauthorized
nodes.notes: Invalid shared secret. Response 401 already sent.

nodes.name: Prepare Page
nodes.notes: Builds one JSON payload so Insert Page uses a single parameterized $1 (quotes, commas and newlines are safe).

nodes.name: Attach Photos
nodes.notes: Insert Page only RETURNINGs id/slug; re-attach the photo list from Map Tally Payload before Split Photos.

_comment: Maps a Tally submission, downloads the uploaded photos, uploads them to Cloudflare R2, persists page/messages/photos, generates a QR and emails the buyer. The webhook authenticates x-latido-secret against $env.TALLY_WEBHOOK_SECRET and returns 401 on mismatch (responseMode=responseNode; the 200 is sent from Respond Accepted before the heavy work). All Postgres values are parameterized; no user data is interpolated into SQL text. TODO(latido): replace the shared secret with Tally native signature once confirmed.
